newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezolano de Credito share dividend okayed.
newsitem.headline: Venezolano de Credito share dividend okayed.

text.p: Venezuela's Banco Venezolano de Credito said Monday its planned one-for-four share dividend had been approved by the National Securities Commission and Banking Superintendency, the Caracas Stock Exchange announced.
The dividend, for shareholders registered to Oct 25 will increase the bank's social capital by 864 million bolivars ($1.8 million), the exchange said in its daily report.
Venezolana de Credito recently had a level one American Depositor Receipt (ADR) issue approved by the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC).
